harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the opsbot account on node1 and node2 (AlmaLinux 9.6), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed its public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and enforced key-only SSH authentication for opsbot on both nodes via a `Match User opsbot` sshd_config block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey). Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH to node2 using the key with no password, and that opsbot's password hash is locked (!! prefix) on both hosts. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and verified sshd, the opsbot account, the enforced key-only sshd policy, and end-to-end key-based SSH access all recovered correctly after both restarts.
actions_performed: Inspected OS and existing sshd_config/user state on node1 and node2
Created opsbot user (useradd -m) and locked its password (passwd -l) on node1 and node2
Generated ed25519 SSH keypair for opsbot on node1 (~/.ssh/id_ed25519)
Installed opsbot's public key into ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for opsbot on node2 with correct permissions
Appended a 'Match User opsbot' block to sshd_config on node1 and node2 enforcing PasswordAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, AuthenticationMethods publickey, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
Validated sshd_config syntax with sshd -t and reloaded sshd on both nodes
Verified functional key-based SSH from opsbot@node1 to opsbot@node2
Verified effective sshd policy for opsbot via sshd -T on both nodes and confirmed locked password hash via getent shadow
Captured boot_id/uptime baseline on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded to return ack before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified sshd active, opsbot intact, key-only policy enforced, and functional SSH to node2 still works
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified sshd active, opsbot intact with locked password, authorized_keys present, key-only policy enforced
Re-verified end-to-end key-based SSH from node1 to node2 as opsbot after both restarts
